UPDATE yunzhanghu_unsign_reconciliations
        SET status = 'resolved',
            lease_owner = NULL,
            lease_expires_at = NULL,
            last_error = 'no_pending_profiles',
            resolved_status = 'ignored',
            resolved_at = NOW(),
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE nonce = $1
          AND status = 'pending'
          AND lease_owner = $2
